title: NTTR retrieval insider describes a cracked egg craft with layered skin

tellings.quote: He spoke about a a cracked egg once that he was on retrieval mission for and there was uh layers like a Russian nesting doll.
>> In a in a in a manned egg that somebody was present for a retrieval for.
tellings.difference: Adds that the egg was manned by grays, and does not mention the layered skin.
tellings.link_reason: Both are uapgerb's secondhand account of a crash-retrieval insider who was on the retrieval of an egg-shaped craft.

as_told.title: Crash retrieval team member saw grays in an egg-shaped craft

plain: A crash retrieval team at the Nevada Test and Training Range, a vast military range, recovered a cracked egg-shaped craft whose skin was built in layers "like a Russian nesting doll." The online researcher known as UAPGerb tells Michels this is what an unnamed member of the team told him; at another point he adds that the egg was manned by grays, the small grey-skinned beings of UFO lore, and leaves out the layers.
